C0254.title: Mini-program piracy operation leads to criminal copyright infringement convictions for two individuals
C0254.summary: In February 2025, Taicang Procuratorate in Jiangsu disclosed an online novel piracy case. Li and Lu used mini programs to illegally copy and distribute original works from an online-novel platform and profited through advertising. The court convicted them of copyright infringement, sentencing Li to three years in prison suspended for four years with an RMB 100,000 fine, and Lu to two years and six months suspended for three years with an RMB 20,000 fine.
